name: connections-review-connector
description: Reviews a connections connector for the administrator about to enable it: what agents can do with it, and what in its rules looks wrong.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One sentence: what agents can do with this connector once enabled

fields.name: reads
fields.description: What agents read without asking, in plain words, one item per kind of data

fields.name: changes
fields.description: What agents change only after the member allows it, in plain words

fields.name: findings
fields.description: Problems in the connector's rules, hosts, scopes or guide, most severe first

item.name: about
item.description: What it is about: a rule, a host, a scope, the guide

item.name: why
item.description: What is wrong and what it lets happen, in one or two sentences

item.name: fix
item.description: A JSON merge patch of the connector that fixes it, or empty
